translation: The condition of injury with diffusion and settling of stagnant blood (瘀血泛注) is caused by blood stasis from falls and blows. This is because qi flows and spreads, while blood, when it spreads, congeals; it may spread into the four limbs and joints, or remain in the chest, abdomen, lower back, and buttocks, or be diffusely swollen, or form lumps. At the onset they all belong to depressed fire of the liver (肝) and spleen (脾). Urgently use the Scallion Ironing Method (蔥熨法), and internally take Minor Bupleurum Decoction (小柴胡湯) to clear the liver fire; next use Eight Treasures Decoction (八珍湯) to strengthen the spleen and stomach, or Qi-Benefiting and Nutritive-Retaining Decoction (益氣養榮湯); with prolonged taking it will naturally achieve its effect.
